invariants: CORPUS-R1: no source whose redistribution != "permitted" may carry capture="body-retained" with a path inside the published tree.
CORPUS-R2: rights, redistribution and capture are REQUIRED on every source; a missing field is an ERROR, never default-permissive.
CORPUS-R3: an exception to R1 must carry rights_review="OPEN" plus a non-empty rights_review_bead and rights_review_reason; a bare exception is a schema error.
CORPUS-R4: an empty sources list is an ERROR, never a vacuous pass.
CORPUS-R6: ai_ingestion="PROHIBITED" forces capture to citation-only or not-vendored.

CORPUS-R7: a body-retained record claiming redistribution="permitted" over third-party rights must carry redistribution_evidence {licence, url, clause}. A bare "permitted" is an assertion, not a licence.
sweep_note: 2026-08-14, bd-corpus-public-captures-not-licensed-class-kej. The nine body captures below were REMOVED from the published tree and reduced to citation rows.
